RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_XILA_STRIKE.title: Strike
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_XILA_DEFEND.title: Defend
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PELLET.title: Pellet
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PELLET.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. {IfUpgraded:show:\nApply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] to all enemies.|}
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PRECISION_LOCK.title: Precision Lock
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PRECISION_LOCK.descrip:
Choose 2 cards to gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
The first [gold]Attack[/gold] you play next turn deals {DamageBoost:diff()}% more damage.
End your turn.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PISTOL_SHOT.title: Pistol Shot
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_RELOAD.title: Reload
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_RELOAD.description: Place all [gold]Strike cards[/gold] into your [gold]hand[/gold], then transform them into {IfUpgraded:show:[green]Pellet+[/green]|[gold]Pellets[/gold]}.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MIXED_BOMB.title: Mixed Bomb
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MIXED_BOMB.description: At the start of your turn, deal {MixedBombPower:diff()} damage to all enemies.\nWhenever you apply a [gold]negative status[/gold] to an enemy, deal {MixedBombPower:diff()} damage to them.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SEEK_COVER.title: Seek Cover
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_DAGGER_STRIKE.title: Dagger Strike
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_DAGGER_STRIKE.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Place 1 [gold]Shiv[/gold] and 1 [gold]Pellet[/gold] into your hand.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_KNIFE_STORM.title: Knife Storm
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_KNIFE_STORM.descriptio: Place {Cards:diff()} {IfUpgraded:show:[green]Shivs+[/green]|[gold]Shivs[/gold]} enchanted with Adroit [green]5[/green] into your hand.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_BACKSTAB.title: Backstab
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_BACKSTAB.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the enemy has [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], deal {IfUpgraded:show:75%|50%} more damage.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_HIDE.title: Hide
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_BERSERKER.title: Berserker
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_BERSERKER.description: All [gold]Attack cards[/gold] in your [gold]hand[/gold] cost 0 this turn.\nCannot gain additional {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} this turn.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_AGILE_STEP.title: Agile Step
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_FLAME_HOOK_PUNCH.title: Flame Hook Punch
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PIERCING_ARROW.title: Piercing Arrow
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PIERCING_ARROW.descrip: Remove all [gold]Block[/gold] from the enemy. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_RABBIT_TRAP.title: Rabbit Trap
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_FIREPOWER_STRIKE.title: Firepower Strike
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_DARK_MOON_SLASH.title: Dark Moon Slash
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SHADOW_WAVE.title: Shadow Wave
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SPIN_LEAP.title: Spin Leap
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SPIN_LEAP.description: Lose 1 HP.\nDeal {Damage:diff()} damage X times to all enemies.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_NIGHT_DOMAIN.title: Night Domain
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_GREATSWORD.d: Gain 3 [gold]Guard[/gold].\nAttack damage you deal is doubled, attack damage enemies deal to you is doubled.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_SHIELD.title: Queen Weapon · Moonlight Shield
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_SHIELD.descr: Gain {IfUpgraded:show:6|4} [gold]Guard[/gold], gain {DarkCurse:secondaryResourceIcons(dark_curse)}.\n[gold]Block[/gold] gained from Skill cards you play is doubled, but attack damage you deal is reduced by 50%.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_STAFF.title: Queen Weapon · Moonlight Staff
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_STAFF.descri: Gain {IfUpgraded:show:5|3} [gold]Guard[/gold].\nThe effects of [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] on all enemies are doubled.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_BLADES.title: Queen Weapon · Moonlight Blades
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_BLADES.descr: Gain {Guard:diff()} [gold]Guard[/gold].\nFor every 2 cards you play, draw 1 card.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_AXE.title: Queen Axe · Primal War Cry
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_AXE.description: Attack cards you play this turn deal double damage.\nDeal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies, apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to all enemies.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_SPEAR.title: Queen Spear · Swift Breathing
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_SPEAR.descriptio: Remove all [gold]Block[/gold] and [gold]Artifact[/gold] from the enemy.\nDeal {Damage:diff()} damage, apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_HARP.title: Queen Harp · Pale Requiem
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_HARP.description: You can no longer switch Queen Weapons.\nAt the start of your turn, apply 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] to all enemies, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_FORM.title: Queen Form
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_FORM.description: Choose 1 from {IfUpgraded:show:Hero Determination+|Hero Determination} and {IfUpgraded:show:Curse Reveal+|Curse Reveal} to add to your hand.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_WIND_FIST.title: Wind Fist
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_WIND_FIST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} times.\nGain 1 temporary [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn. When you switch [gold]Queen Weapons[/gold], add this card to your [gold]hand[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_HERO_DETERMINATION.des: At the start of each turn, gain {IfUpgraded:show:[green]15[/green]|10} [gold]Guard[/gold].\nWhen you play an [gold]Attack card[/gold], deal additional damage equal to your current [gold]Guard[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_CURSE_REVEAL.title: Curse Reveal
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_CURSE_REVEAL.descripti: Gain 999 [gold]Doom[/gold].\nRestore your {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} to maximum, gain the effects of all Skill Queen Weapons.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_ASA_RAINBOW_GEM.title: Asa's Rainbow Gem
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_ASA_RAINBOW_GEM.descri: Choose 1 Attack card from {Cards} cards of other characters{IfUpgraded:show:[green] (upgraded)[/green]} and add it to your hand.\nThis card costs 0 for the rest of combat.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_FARRAH_HELL_ASH.title: Farrah's Hell Ash
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_FARRAH_HELL_ASH.descri: Whenever a card is Exhausted, gain {Guard:diff()} [gold]Guard[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MEL_THORN_FERN.title: Mel's Thorn Fern
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MEL_THORN_FERN.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Apply [gold]Doom[/gold] and [gold]Poison[/gold] equal to the damage dealt.
QUEEN_WEAPON_HOVER_TIP.title: Queen Weapon
QUEEN_WEAPON_HOVER_TIP.description: When you play a Queen Weapon card, switch the Queen Weapon effect.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_GRADUATION_CROW.title: Graduation Crow's Knowledge
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_GRADUATION_CROW.descri: Choose any {IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded |}card to add to your hand. Play it for free this combat. Exhaust.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_GRADUATION_CROW.flavor: A flock of crows flies across the sky, bringing wisdom and opportunity from afar.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Your next [gold]Attack[/gold] card deals triple damage. End your turn.
Steel fangs tear through all obstacles in an instant.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MITHRIL_DRAGON_MARCH.d: Exhaust your hand. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies for each card exhausted. Clear all your [gold]Guard[/gold] stacks.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MITHRIL_DRAGON_MARCH.f: The mithril dragon takes flight, and its army sweeps across the battlefield.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_KNIGHT_MOUSE_SHIELD_FO: [gold]Block[/gold] no longer resets at the start of your turn. {IfUpgraded:show:Innate. |}This effect is lost when your [gold]Guard[/gold] stacks are cleared.
The knight mouse raises its shield, forming an unshakeable defense line.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_WITCH_CURSE_RESIDUE.de: Draw until you have {IfUpgraded:show:9|7} cards. Restore {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} to your max{IfUpgraded:show: x2|}. Gain 13 [gold]Doom[/gold], 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], 1 [gold]Weak[/gold], 1 [gold]Frail[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_WITCH_CURSE_RESIDUE.fl: The curse lingers within, both a hex and a source of power.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_STARLIGHT_FROG_DANCE.d: When you inflict a debuff you haven't inflicted before, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. {IfUpgraded:show:Innate. |}
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_STARLIGHT_FROG_DANCE.f: Under the starlight, the frog's croak echoes — each note a brand new melody.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_HOLD_THE_POSITION.desc: At the start of your turn, put a card from your discard pile into your hand and give it [gold]Retain[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_HOLD_THE_POSITION.flav: Hold the line — what was lost shall return to your grasp.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_STAR_SEAL.title: Star Seal
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_STAR_SEAL.description: When played, clear your [gold]Guard[/gold] stacks. At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_STAR_SEAL.flavor: Sealed by starlight — trade defense for explosive momentum.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_FALLING_PETALS.title: Falling Petals
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_FALLING_PETALS.flavor: Petals fall — each one blooming with fierce momentum.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_FLAME_SHADOW_STEP.flav: Step through the flame — and leave the fire behind.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SPELL_THRUSTS.title: Spell Thrusts
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SPELL_THRUSTS.flavor: The curse hums — then strikes, twice over.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SPELL_CHANT.title: Spell Chant
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SPELL_CHANT.flavor: Whisper the incantation — the curse swells in answer.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SPELL_FLYING_THORNS.de: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies X times. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] X times.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SPELL_FLYING_THORNS.fl: Thorns of dark curse scatter — striking again and again.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PANIC.title: Panic!!
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PANIC.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Gain {secondaryResource:secondaryResourceIcons(dark_curse)} equal to damage dealt. Apply 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to all enemies.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PANIC.flavor: A scream of dark curse — and everything falls apart.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_REVERSE_SPELL.title: Reverse Spell
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_REVERSE_SPELL.descript: Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to all enemies. Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_REVERSE_SPELL.flavor: Turn the incantation inside out — and let it sting.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_RAGE.title: Rage!!
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_RAGE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you are in [gold]Queen Weapon[/gold] state, gain {Guard:diff()} [gold]Guard[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_RAGE.flavor: The curse boils over — the queen's blade answers.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_JEALOUSY.title: Jealousy!!
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_JEALOUSY.description: Choose an enemy. If its intent is to attack, draw {DrawCount:diff()} cards. Otherwise, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_JEALOUSY.flavor: Your enemy lunges — and you take what they wanted.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SORROW.title: Sorrow!!
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SORROW.description: Gain {DarkCurse:secondaryResourceIcons(dark_curse)}. If you have gained {IfUpgraded:show:66|99} {secondaryResource:secondaryResourceIcons(dark_curse)} this run, transform this card into True Friendship.\n{secondaryResource:secondaryResourceIcons(dark_curse)} gained this run: {RunDarkCurseGained}.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SORROW.flavor: Weep, and let the curse carve a path.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_TRUE_FRIENDSHIP.title: True Friendship
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_TRUE_FRIENDSHIP.flavor: The one who shared your sorrow — now shares your power.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_HERO_GREATSWORD.title: Queen Weapon: Hero Greatsword
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_HERO_GREATSWORD.descri: Retain. Gain 3 [gold]Guard[/gold].\nThe next [gold]Queen Weapon[/gold] card can be played for free.\nAttacks you play deal double damage, but enemy attacks deal double damage to you.
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_HERO_GREATSWORD.flavor: The relic tooth remembers your first vow — and returns it sharpened.
